text:
sam: FYI the release pipeline flagged a minor for the sample-app because regendiff shows lots of example value changes. pipeline bumped the SDKs automatically. anyone have context?
ci-bot: sample-app tests failed (unit): 9 failing. regendiff: https://ci.internal/redwood/regendiff/3032150000 :warning:
liz: looked at the regendiff. most diffs are `examples` and a property ordering change in the OpenAPI -> this should not be a minor. semver tool currently treats any schema change as potential minor.
heng: also hitting a Go client break: typegen reordered optional args on `UpdateFoo` causing import ambiguity in sampleapp. quick error: `sampleapp/main.go:32: cannot use client.UpdateFoo (type main.UpdateFoo) as field value` (paraphrased).
sam: here's my minimal reproduce log: ```bash
$ tools/regenerate openapi.yaml
Generated: openapi.regen.json
- components.schemas.Account.properties.id.examples: ["acc_123"] -> ["acc_1234"]
- paths./v1/items.post.requestBody.content.application/json.schema.properties.options: order changed
```
liz: short term we should: 1) teach changeloggen to ignore `examples` and `example` fields, 2) make typegen property iteration deterministic across languages, 3) have semver tool classify example-only diffs as patch. I'll draft the changelog PR.
heng: i'll pin a stable sort in the Go typegen and add a unit that verifies output order across runs. will also open a revert PR if needed.
ci-bot: release-bot has prevented publish, canary staging blocked.
sam: if we can't land patches within 90 minutes we should disable the automatic bump step and re-run after manual check. prefer small automation change to avoid rollbacks.
buildifier: FYI the auth/retry failures from earlier were magnified by randomized jitter in tests; switched tests to fixed jitter seed in my branch to ensure deterministic reruns.
liz: PRs: https://github.com/redwood/changeloggen/pull/107 (WIP), https://github.com/redwood/typegen/pull/432 (WIP). i'll add a changelog unit to assert `examples` don't promote semver.
sam: thanks all. once both PRs land coordinate with release-team to unhold the publish. i'll drop a short note in #devops with the rollback plan. :thumbsup:
